```yaml
name: Pre-commit Execute
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  validate-and-dispatch:
    if: github.event.comment.body == '@github-actions run precommit'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check if PR author is collaborator
        id: check_collaborator
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: pullRequest } = await github.rest.pulls.get({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: context.issue.number
            });
            
            const { data: isCollaborator } = await github.rest.repos.checkCollaborator({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              username: pullRequest.user.login
            });
            
            const isAuthor = pullRequest.user.login === context.actor;
            
            if (!isAuthor && !isCollaborator) {
              throw new Error('Only PR author or repository collaborators can trigger pre-commit');
            }
            
            return { isAuthor, isCollaborator };
      
      - name: Dispatch to execution workflow
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            await github.rest.actions.createWorkflowDispatch({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              workflow_id: 'precommit-execute.yml',
              ref: 'main',
              inputs: {
                pr_number: '${{ context.issue.number }}',
                actor: '${{ context.actor }}'
              }
            });

  execute-precommit:
    needs: validate-and-dispatch
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.pr_number != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: refs/pull/${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}/head
      
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          
      - name: Install pre-commit
        run: |
          pip install pre-commit
          
      - name: Run pre-commit
        run: |
          pre-commit run --all-files
          
      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add .
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "Automated pre-commit fixes"
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
